definition.note: A hexagonal triply periodic minimal surface family that 3DXM exhibits as 'A Schoen TW Family': Karcher's T-Wp ('wrapped package') surface, made in Schoen's spirit but not in the NASA report; the alpha = beta = 60-degree member of the conjugate-contour family whose 45-degree member is I-WP.

provenance.definition: Derived from the Math Art generator registries and cross-referenced to the literature; not transcribed from any gallery's compilation.
